rules.title: RSO Annual Allowable Rent Increase (2025-2026)
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) are capped at 3% from July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026.

coverage.summary: Applies to units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
coverage.unresolvable: Requires checking property status on zimas.lacity.org or via text service to determine if a unit is under the RSO.

rules.quoted_span: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026 is 3%.

rules.title: Prohibition on Additional Utility Percentage Increases
rules.requirement: Beginning February 2, 2026, landlords can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.

coverage.summary: Applies to RSO units in the City of Los Angeles.
coverage.unresolvable: Requires checking property status on zimas.lacity.org to determine if a unit is under the RSO.
